title: Subscriber DB /data full after archive catch-up run
summary: Archive shipping caught up after a link outage and wrote two days of transaction log archives back to /data. /data reached 100%, database writes failed, and balance, bundle and SMS services failed with it.
fix_description: Purged archived transaction logs older than 24 hours (oldest first, 8.8 GiB). Services recovered within 3 minutes.
